tools.name: reap
tools.title: bops reap
tools.description: Release stale claims that hold no work. Runs `bops reap --json` and returns its JSON document; exit 3 (a negative verdict, ok:false) is a result, not an error. Preview only here: it changes neither the ledger nor the claim refs, and dry-run false is refused; hand a person the `bops reap --dry-run=false --only <only>,... (each would_release entry's only: <id>@<run>, or the bare id when its run cannot be pinned; skip an entry without one)` command to run.

cursor.description: Only to continue a paginated result: the cursor the previous page gave. Other arguments are then ignored.

dry-run.description: Only true (or absent) here: false is refused. A real run is a person's, at the CLI.

forge.description: Forge searched for open or merged merge requests naming each claim with no other evidence; none searches nothing, with a warning.

older-than.description: Idle longer than this is stale, as for stale; shorter than stale_minutes is refused.

only.description: Comma-separated bead ids, normally the ones a preview listed under would_release: act on these only. <id>@<run> also pins the holder the preview showed: a claim held now by another run is listed under skipped, not released. Each would_release entry's only is the entry to pass: <id>@<run>, or the bare id when its run is empty, - or outside A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -, which cannot be pinned; none when the id is not a valid bead id. One that is no longer a stale claim is listed under skipped; an empty list is a usage error. A claim made outside bops (no run label, no ref) is released only when named here.

Preview only here: it changes neither the ledger nor the claim refs, and dry-run false is refused; hand a person the `bops gc --dry-run=false --only <id>,... (from the preview)` command to run.

dry-run.description: Only true (or absent) here: false is refused. A real run is a person's, at the CLI.

forge.description: Forge searched, as reap searches it, for open or merged merge requests naming the bead of an orphan, or of a closed bead whose ref is newer than its last ledger change, that shows no other work; none searches nothing, with a warning.

only.description: Comma-separated bead ids, normally the ones a preview listed under would_delete: act on these only. One whose ref is no longer one gc deletes is listed under skipped; one with no ref at all is a warning; an empty list is a usage error.
